prompt: Create a production transparent PNG sprite-part atlas for a Cocos pixel-art game, based on the reference character identity. NOT a poster, no text, no labels, no background, no ground shadows. Exactly 10 columns by 5 rows, equal grid cells, one isolated body part centered in every cell, generous transparent spacing. 1536x1024 landscape sheet. The FIVE rows depict FIVE viewing directions of SAME character: row1 facing down toward camera/front; row2 facing down-right three-quarter front; row3 facing screen-right profile; row4 facing up-right three-quarter back; row5 facing away/back. All are mildly elevated game camera, 26-degree view down onto ground. Each row has exactly TEN isolated joint-connected parts in this order: column1 bald head with short neck; column2 torso INCLUDING hips and ragged short tunic ending at upper thigh, no limbs; column3 left upper arm from shoulder to elbow; column4 left forearm INCLUDING hand; column5 right upper arm shoulder to elbow; column6 right forearm INCLUDING hand; column7 left thigh hip to knee; column8 left shin INCLUDING foot; column9 right thigh hip to knee; column10 right shin INCLUDING foot. Arms and legs in relaxed nearly vertical positions; round solid overlapping joint ends designed for skeletal rotation. Full pieces, no sliced truncations. Do not duplicate a whole character anywhere. Body is lean adult, ancient dried ashen corpse, pale gray ivory skin, absolutely bald, faceless dark shadow on front of head, NO eyes/nose/mouth/ears or hair, NO mask or hood, no blood. Neutral worn dark charcoal-purple cloth tunic and short trousers, tan waist wrap, pale cloth forearm and ankle wraps. Tiny warm dry ember in chest visible only front views. Match reference material palette and identity. Crisp hand-designed pixel clusters, limited approximately 24-color palette, hard stepped shading, no antialiasing or gradients, clear dark outline. Logical sprite size about 80 pixels tall when assembled; every body part should have appropriately proportional pixel detail, not high-resolution painting. Keep head, torso and all limbs consistent across rows. Transparent alpha everywhere outside the pieces.
processing: PNG copied byte-for-byte. Read-only alpha component measurements selected SpriteFrame rectangles. Duplicate garment tops in thigh cells excluded by frame rectangle. No image pixels rewritten.
